# section: # Function declarations: function0 parameter entry/FP binding; function2 array suffix;
# function4 signature/slot binding; function6 definition-versus-prototype dispatch;
# function8 definition spills, structure copies, body and return; function9 block prototype.
# Parameter arrays accept one side-effect-free bound token per existing reader.
# Nested literal ellipsis retains the existing stacked-argument ABI selection.
# Prototypes unwind parameter names without clearing an earlier definition.
# Spill all incoming arguments before structure copies clobber r0-r2.
# Only definitions allocate the return label; reaching main's closing brace returns zero.
# Global declarations: global0 dispatches current TWORDS; global1 binds enum constants and typedef names.
# global3 stores typedef descriptors, finishes the unit, replays initializers and selects declarators.
# global5 classifies storage, emits scalar/aggregate initializers once and records globals.
# Non-string-array initializer tape is cached at its declaration and replayed by IN.vcopy.
# Character arrays share STRINGINIT; initializer walks, shape and enum descriptors remain shared.
# A unit requires main; a defined exit is called on main return before the common exit sequence.
# R13-0b #31: a file-scope `static` is remembered until the next declaration path (FN) takes it
# (fstat_cur) and clears it; FN.sp then records the function label as static (STATICF[id] = 1)
# for the unresolved-call check.  `extern` still takes TOP.st.
# H1-1: declaration linkage is independent of emitted-storage identity.
